params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: Opening the "rate the seller" link for a bidding that does not exist crashes with a 500 instead of answering 404. One occurrence in production so far (Nightwatch #82).

## What happens

`GET ownvehicle/{vehicle}/addDealerVote` (`VotingController::addDealerVote`, the no-login page where the winner of a bidding rates the selling dealer, R B1-5.11) looks up the export vehicle by the base64 id in the URL, trashed rows included, and reads `$export_vehicle->vehicle_id` without checking the lookup found anything. An id that matches no export vehicle (a mangled or truncated mail link, a guessed URL, a crawler) gives:

```
ErrorException: Attempt to read property "vehicle_id" on null
app/Http/Controllers/Vehicle/VotingController.php:140
```

Seen once on production, 2026-11-26 08:47 UTC, Laravel 13.42.0, PHP 8.5.12.

The POST of the same page (`storeDealerVote`) already answers 404 for a missing bidding; the GET does not.

## Expected

A missing bidding is a 404, like the POST and like the other rating doors in this controller.

Source: Portal mail:72 (a forwarded Nightwatch alert, issue #82).
params.title: Rate-the-seller link for an unknown bidding crashes with a 500 instead of a 404
